{{Top|leg}}
'''Interceptor Eight''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] assigned to the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] [[Intrepid (Endurance-class)|''Intrepid'']] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Battle Group]].

Immediately prior to the [[Battle of Doornik-319]], Interceptor Eight was one of the squadrons prepared for immediate launch aboard the ''Intrepid'', and when the ''Intrepid'' entered the system, Interceptor Eight was part of the fleet carrier's fighter screen, and participated in the ensuing battle during the [[Yevetha]]n ambush.
